description: This file defines a class 'ImageAlternativeTextFormView' that renders a form UI for editing alternative text for images, including toggles, input fields, and buttons, within the CKEditor5 framework.

classes.name: ImageAlternativeTextFormView
classes.description: A class rendering alternative text form view with focus management, toggle, input, and action buttons.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the form view, focus management, and UI components.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and focusable elements after rendering.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up focus and keystroke handlers.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates a button view with specified label, icon, class, and event delegation.

methods.name: _createLabeledInputView
methods.description: Creates a labeled input field for alternative text.

methods.name: _decorativeToggleView
methods.description: Creates a toggle switch for marking the image as decorative.
